mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 53 degrees at the high school with clear skies and an elevated air quality index of 75. We have a full moon tonight and an ISS flyover, though you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has published its 2027 budget and is preparing for a November 4th Plan Commission meeting featuring several projects, including the Ardent Glen addition, new site plans on Milky Way, and property tax information, with bills hitting mailboxes by December 15th.

There is plenty to do, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market today. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Looking ahead, check out yoga on October 26th or various trivia nights starting October 27th.
On Thursday, October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving, though no students were injured during the incident.
Today's flavor of the day is Turtle, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
